name: usage-meter
title: Usage Meter
description: How much of something is used, as a meter (role=meter, its name and value said): a ring or a bar in the foreground's greys, the app's words after it, on its own or in a Badge as a quota chip. Its breakdown's popover is no wider or higher than the room it has, its rows scrolling (a keyboard stop where they do), its title, meter and footer kept; contentClassName gives it the app's classes. UsageMeterBreakdown is a button with the meter that opens a popover: its title and value on one line, a bar of the whole, and the app's rows of label and value in grey; rows with an amount are parts of the bar, each a grey of its own (no colour), and a row's separator starts a group (e.g. cost after context). In an input group, as a composer's toolbar, it opens 8px above the group, not over its text. Every word is the app's. Its fill in the theme's warning or destructive colour with `tone`, near a limit and at it, on the ring, the bar and the breakdown's bar, the track as it was. UsageMeterList: several meters at a glance (a popup of an account's limits), each its label and value on a line, a bar across under them and a line of detail (when it resets), 12px apart, each a meter to a screen reader.
